title: 红楼梦 — 小说精读 No.4
title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber — Novels, Deep-Read No.4

questions.question: 文章认为第五回把所有人的结局提前公开，起了什么作用？
options: 用隐晦的画和判词制造一连串谜题，吸引读者一路猜测每个人物的最终结局
借梦境交代贾府的家族来历，为后文铺设人物关系网
把读者的问题从「会怎样」换成「怎么会这样」，让日常有了重量
暗示结局并非注定，只要宝玉记住警示就能避开灾祸
questions.explanation: 文章说这是中国小说史上最大胆的赌博：主动扔掉「接下来会怎样」的动力，换来「怎么会这样」，读者以近乎神的位置看书，一顿家常饭因此有了倒计时。开头也明说这本书没打算跟你玩悬念，所以「制造谜题让人猜」不是它的用意。
questions.question_en: According to the piece, what does revealing everyone's fate early, in Chapter 5, accomplish?
options_en: It plants a string of cryptic pictures and verses that keep readers guessing every character's final fate
It uses the dream to lay out the family's origins and set up the web of relationships
It shifts the reader's question from "what will happen" to "how could it come to this," giving everyday scenes a countdown-like weight
It hints that fate isn't fixed — Baoyu could avoid disaster if he heeded the warning
questions.explanation_en: The piece calls it the boldest gamble in Chinese fiction: abandoning "what next" in exchange for "how could this happen," putting the reader in a near-godlike position so that an ordinary family meal carries a countdown. The opening states outright that the book isn't playing the suspense game, so riddles for guessing aren't the point.

questions.question: 文章把贾府衰败的「引信」归结为什么？
options: 宝玉不肯走仕途经济之路，家族后继无人而逐渐中落
进项全系于皇恩与元春，体面全靠花钱，两者同时到期
王熙凤私放高利贷败露，直接触发了朝廷的查抄
政敌趁元妃去世之后联手构陷，朝中的外部势力最终把贾府彻底打垮
questions.explanation: 文章说引信不是某一件事，而是一个结构：这座府一直在借将来的钱过今天的日子，而它的将来就是元春的一条命。高利贷等旧账是抄家时被一并翻出来的，并非根源；探春那句「自杀自灭」也说明它是从里面撕开的，不是被外敌打倒的。
questions.question_en: What does the piece identify as the "fuse" of the Jia family's collapse?
options_en: Baoyu refused an official career, leaving the family without a successor so it slowly declined
All income depended on imperial favor via Yuanchun, all prestige on constant spending, and both came due at once
Wang Xifeng's secret moneylending was exposed and directly triggered the confiscation
Political enemies conspired after the consort's death, and outside forces at court finally brought the house down
questions.explanation_en: The piece says the fuse wasn't any single event but a structure: the household kept borrowing against the future to live today, and its future was Yuanchun's life. Old misdeeds like the moneylending surfaced during the raid; they weren't the root. Tanchun's line about destroying themselves from within shows it was torn apart from inside, not toppled by enemies.

questions.question: 文章如何解读「抄检大观园」？
options: 清查主要针对探春这些主子小姐，丫鬟们只是顺带被殃及
香囊主人始终没查出，被撵的全是没靠山的人，掏空家族的男人毫发无伤
抄检查实了园中的私情，证明大观园的管理确实存在严重漏洞
王夫人纯属道德洁癖发作，园中有私情的风声其实对这些姑娘的婚事不构成任何实际风险
questions.explanation: 文章指出一场清洗需要的不是证据，是一个可以开始的理由；代价落在晴雯、入画这些成本最低的人身上，贾赦、贾珍、贾琏一根头发也没动。它也特意承认王夫人的恐惧真实且致命——风声传出去，几十个女孩子的婚事全完，所以「不构成风险」不对。
questions.question_en: How does the piece read the search of the Grand View Garden?
options_en: The search mainly targeted the young mistresses like Tanchun; the maids were collateral damage
The pouch's owner was never found, those expelled were all the ones with no backing, and the men who drained the family went untouched
The search confirmed the affairs in the garden and proved its management had serious gaps
Lady Wang was simply prudish; rumors of romance posed no real risk to the girls' marriage prospects
questions.explanation_en: The piece notes a purge needs not evidence but a reason to begin; the cost fell on Qingwen and Ruhua, the cheapest people to remove, while Jia She, Jia Zhen and Jia Lian lost not a hair. It also stresses that Lady Wang's fear was real — leaked rumors could wreck dozens of girls' marriages — so "no real risk" is wrong.
